game/godot-pixel-art-blurry.cta: Nerulio can prepare a Godot bundle with pixel-art import settings; camera and viewport decisions still belong to your project.

game/sprite-jitter-after-trim.cta: Nerulio provides sprite placement and jitter inspection alongside engine export; keep intended motion when choosing a correction.

game/aseprite-to-godot.cta: Nerulio reads Aseprite files in the browser and exports a Godot 4 SpriteFrames resource, atlas and scene with timing conversion.

game/sprite-sheet-frame-size.cta: Nerulio previews detected grid candidates and custom cell, offset and gap values before slicing a sprite sheet.

game/normal-map-opengl-or-directx.cta: Nerulio can inspect normal-map conventions and preview lighting; uncertain classifications still need a known-shape light test.

game/godot-terrain-wrong-tiles.cta: Nerulio checks tile-pattern coverage and previews terrain rules; rebuilding from an image does not import an existing Godot TileSet resource.

game/pixel-art-cleanup.cta: Nerulio offers shared-palette cleanup and candidate review; compare the silhouette and animation before accepting changes.

game/keep-aseprite-tags-when-packing.cta: Nerulio imports Aseprite sources or supported JSON metadata and writes engine-specific animation data with target-specific limitations.
